F-002-contrast_finding_to_record.claim: HDD VCM is deliberately engineered to operate in the c-regime with sharp resonance peaks. The plant itself sits FAR from chit ≈ 0; external closed-loop control closes the gap.
contrasts_with: Engines (F-002-engine): tune to chit ≈ 0 at idle by SOC self-tuning of ECU/carburetor.
Loudspeakers (Phase E F-002-loudspeaker shelved): sit at chit ≈ 0 by radiation efficiency cap (~1-3%).
F-002-contrast_finding_to_record.framework_implication: The SOC-attractor reading of F-002 from engines is substrate-conditional, not universal. Some substrates are engineered to live near chit ≈ 0; others are engineered to live far and have external controllers close the gap. cdv1 §Active modulation handles the plant+controller decomposition explicitly.
